reason: Canonical phone projection validator previously required a literal active CLAIMED_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION state even after the StegID freshness claim had been durably released. That made current main validation fail after release unless an unrelated active product claim happened to exist.
correction: Parse the claim registry structurally; require the StegID freshness claim to exist in a released terminal state on canonical branches; validate any active product claim has a release condition; preserve all existing projection/security invariants.
